agreed_to_terms.description: User has agreed to terms and privacy policy.

AccountRegistration.description: Request to create a new account.

ArtifactTrustStatus.title: ArtifactTrustStatus
ArtifactTrustStatus.description: Lifecycle status of the scientific artifact produced by a run.

details.title: Details
details.description: Opaque detail safe for logging; must not expose internal state.

AuthError.title: AuthError
AuthError.description:
Uniform authentication error response.

Errors intentionally share the same shape to avoid leaking whether an email
is registered, whether a password is wrong, or whether a token exists.

AuthResponse.title: AuthResponse
AuthResponse.description:
Response to a successful authentication operation.

The session_token is delivered only once; callers must store it according to
their client type (browser cookie managed by the API, native secure storage).

task_type.title: Task Type
task_type.description: Logical task type, e.g. ingestion, index.

object_domain.description: Domain in which the task runs.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: Project scope when the task belongs to a project.

authorization_version.title: Authorization Version
authorization_version.description: Authorization policy version at task creation.

key_epoch.title: Key Epoch
key_epoch.description: Key epoch under which task secrets are bound.

object_refs.title: Object Refs
object_refs.description: Object identifiers the task is authorized to touch.

memory_slice_refs.title: Memory Slice Refs
memory_slice_refs.description: Memory slice identifiers compiled for the task.

BackgroundTaskEnvelope.title: BackgroundTaskEnvelope
BackgroundTaskEnvelope.description:
Required context for every background task.

A background task must carry a subject, object domain, project, authorization
version and key epoch. Missing any of these causes deterministic failure
closure rather than running with ambient or guessed context.

run_id.title: Run Id
run_id.description: Run to which the capsule is bound.

CapsuleIssueRequest.title: CapsuleIssueRequest
CapsuleIssueRequest.description: Request to issue a temporary task capsule for a vault object.

CapsuleStatus.title: CapsuleStatus
CapsuleStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a temporary task capsule.

ChunkCorrection.title: ChunkCorrection
ChunkCorrection.description:
A human correction to a single chunk.

Corrections create a new DocumentVersion so history is preserved.

ChunkStructurePath.title: ChunkStructurePath
ChunkStructurePath.description: Hierarchical location of a chunk within a document.

ChunkVersion.title: ChunkVersion
ChunkVersion.description:
A structural chunk of a document version.

Chunks are the smallest retrievable units that preserve locator information
so that claims and citations can point back to precise positions.

claim_id.title: Claim Id
claim_id.description: Claim this citation supports in the output.

locator.description: Precise location in the source version.

identifier_snapshot.title: Identifier Snapshot
identifier_snapshot.description: DOI, PMID, arXiv ID, etc. at citation creation time.

source_version_label.title: Source Version Label
source_version_label.description: Document version label, e.g. v1, v2.

verification_status.description: Current verification state of the locator against the source.

verification_reason.title: Verification Reason
verification_reason.description: Human-readable reason for the verification status.

Citation.title: Citation
Citation.description:
A rendered citation binding wording to evidence with a precise locator.

Citation records are immutable; when the source version changes or the
locator becomes stale, a new citation version is created rather than
overwriting history.

start_offset.title: Start Offset
start_offset.description: Start character offset in the document version.

end_offset.title: End Offset
end_offset.description: End character offset in the document version.

CitationLocator.title: CitationLocator
CitationLocator.description: Precise location of a citation within a document version.

current_document_id.title: Current Document Id
current_document_id.description: Current document version id if source is still active.

CitationValidationResult.title: CitationValidationResult
CitationValidationResult.description: Result of re-verifying a citation against the current source state.

CitationVerificationStatus.title: CitationVerificationStatus
CitationVerificationStatus.description: Verification state of a single citation locator.

graph_id.title: Graph Id
graph_id.description: Claim graph this claim belongs to.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Scope qualifier such as population, conditions or time range.

status_reason.title: Status Reason
status_reason.description: Why the claim has this status.

superseded_by_claim_id.title: Superseded By Claim Id
superseded_by_claim_id.description: Newer claim version that replaces this one.

model_run_lock_id.title: Model Run Lock Id
model_run_lock_id.description: Model run lock that produced or reviewed this claim.

Claim.title: Claim
Claim.description: A single scientific proposition produced from retrieval and validation.

run_id.title: Run Id
run_id.description: Workflow run that produced the graph.

query.title: Query
query.description: Question or task that generated the graph.

status_reason.title: Status Reason
status_reason.description: Why the graph has this status.

index_snapshot_id.title: Index Snapshot Id
index_snapshot_id.description: Index used to build the graph.

superseded_by_graph_id.title: Superseded By Graph Id
superseded_by_graph_id.description: Newer graph version that replaces this one.

model_run_lock_id.title: Model Run Lock Id
model_run_lock_id.description: Model run lock that produced the graph.

ClaimGraph.title: ClaimGraph
ClaimGraph.description: A versioned collection of claims, evidence and citations for one answer.

search_result.description: Retrieval result that fed the graph.

publish_gate.description: Publish gate run against the graph.

model_run_lock.description: Lock for the model call that generated claims.

ClaimGraphResult.title: ClaimGraphResult
ClaimGraphResult.description: Result of generating a claim graph from a question.

ClaimImportance.title: ClaimImportance
ClaimImportance.description: Importance of a claim within an answer.

run_id.title: Run Id
run_id.description: Optional workflow run to bind the graph to.

ClaimRequest.title: ClaimRequest
ClaimRequest.description:
Request to generate a claim graph from a scientific question.

The service compiles scope first, runs hybrid retrieval, then produces
claim-level evidence and citations against the retrieved source versions.

ClaimTrustStatus.title: ClaimTrustStatus
ClaimTrustStatus.description:
Trust status of a claim or claim graph.

Mirrors the honest-degradation state machine from the scientific-trust
research: verified, qualified, partial, conflicted, metadata_only,
quarantined and blocked are all legal terminal or intermediate states.

content_hash.title: Content Hash
content_hash.description: Cryptographic hash of the authoritative content (sha256).

content_length.title: Content Length
content_length.description: Length of the authoritative content in bytes.

key_epoch.title: Key Epoch
key_epoch.description: Key epoch under which the object is protected.

authorization_version.title: Authorization Version
authorization_version.description: Authorization policy version that governs this projection.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: If set, the projection becomes invalid after this time.

CloudControlProjection.title: CloudControlProjection
CloudControlProjection.description:
Minimal cloud-side projection of a vault object.

The cloud control projection intentionally does not store the full plaintext.
It carries only enough metadata to authorize, scope, sync, and audit the
object without exposing private content.

CloudProjectionStatus.title: CloudProjectionStatus
CloudProjectionStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a cloud control projection.

graph_id.title: Graph Id
graph_id.description: Claim graph this conflict belongs to.

materiality.title: Materiality
materiality.description: Materiality of the conflict, e.g. key, supporting, illustrative.

Conflict.title: Conflict
Conflict.description:
An explicit, user-visible evidence conflict.

Conflicts are first-class scientific objects. They are not exceptions and
are not resolved by model voting or last-write-wins.

ContentAuthority.title: ContentAuthority
ContentAuthority.description:
Where the authoritative plaintext of a vault object resides.

- DEVICE_LOCAL: the full content is authoritative on the user's device. The
  cloud only holds a control projection (hash and metadata).
- SERVER_REPLICA: the server holds an encrypted replica for synchronization;
  the device is not required for every read.
- PROJECT_COPY: a minimized copy owned by a shared project, detached from the
  personal vault original.

gap_type.title: Gap Type
gap_type.description: Type of gap, e.g. lexical, vector, scope.

CoverageGap.title: CoverageGap
CoverageGap.description: A coverage or recall gap reported to the caller.

required.title: Required
required.description: Whether this dependency is required for the service to be ready.

latency_ms.title: Latency Ms
latency_ms.description: Probe latency in milliseconds if measured.

can_retry_at.title: Can Retry At
can_retry_at.description: If known, the earliest time the device may be reachable again.

DeviceUnavailableState.title: DeviceUnavailableState
DeviceUnavailableState.description:
Legal wait state when the authoritative device is not available.

The system returns this instead of silently uploading full text from another
source or falling back to a stale replica.

version_label.title: Version Label
version_label.description: Human-readable version label, e.g. v1, v2.

content_hash.title: Content Hash
content_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of raw content bytes.

raw_blob_ref.title: Raw Blob Ref
raw_blob_ref.description: Reference to encrypted raw content object.

DocumentVersion.title: DocumentVersion
DocumentVersion.description:
Immutable content snapshot of a source.

Each new upload, correction or re-parse creates a new DocumentVersion; older
versions remain addressable so citations can be verified against the exact
snapshot that produced them.

case_id.title: Case Id
case_id.description: Case identifier; null evaluates the whole suite snapshot.

runtime_identifier.title: Runtime Identifier
runtime_identifier.description: Runtime carrier used to produce the lock.

EvaluationCreateRequest.title: EvaluationCreateRequest
EvaluationCreateRequest.description: Request to create an evaluation run from a completed project task run.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Diff kind: changed, added_a, added_b, removed_a, removed_b.

EvaluationDiffEntry.title: EvaluationDiffEntry
EvaluationDiffEntry.description: One field difference between two evaluation result bundles.

lock_match.title: Lock Match
lock_match.description: True when both bundles share the same evaluation run lock.

result_diffs.title: Result Diffs
result_diffs.description: Differences in outputs, status and metrics.

failure_diffs.title: Failure Diffs
failure_diffs.description: Differences in failure category and reason.

EvaluationDiffProjection.title: EvaluationDiffProjection
EvaluationDiffProjection.description: Comparison of two evaluation result bundles in the evaluation center.

details.title: Details
details.description: Opaque detail safe for logging; must not expose internal state.

EvaluationFailureCategory.title: EvaluationFailureCategory
EvaluationFailureCategory.description: High-level failure classification for an evaluation result.

slice_tag.title: Slice Tag
slice_tag.description: Risk slice or subgroup tag, e.g. high_risk, novice.

EvaluationMetric.title: EvaluationMetric
EvaluationMetric.description: A single derived metric in a result bundle.

lock_id.title: Lock Id
lock_id.description: Evaluation run lock that produced this bundle.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: Project within which the bundle is scoped.

status.description: Final status of the evaluation run.

run_projection.description: Task-stage projection produced by replay, if any.

outputs.title: Outputs
outputs.description: Structured outputs produced by the replayed run.

state_trajectory.title: State Trajectory
state_trajectory.description: Ordered run-status values observed during replay.

typed_artifact_refs.title: Typed Artifact Refs
typed_artifact_refs.description: References to typed artifacts produced during replay.

model_tool_calls.title: Model Tool Calls
model_tool_calls.description: Model/tool invocation locks observed during replay.

failure_reason.title: Failure Reason
failure_reason.description: Human-readable failure reason without internal details.

derived_metrics.title: Derived Metrics
derived_metrics.description: Derived metrics such as latency, cost, coverage.

logs_and_traces.title: Logs And Traces
logs_and_traces.description: Scrubbed logs and trace references; no private body.

reproduction_command.title: Reproduction Command
reproduction_command.description: Exact command that can replay this evaluation run.

environment_summary.title: Environment Summary
environment_summary.description: Environment summary for the runner that produced this bundle.

EvaluationResultBundle.title: EvaluationResultBundle
EvaluationResultBundle.description:
Saved result of one evaluation execution.

Bundles are append-only: replaying the same lock produces a new bundle rather
than overwriting the old one. They never include private body, full prompts,
secrets or unnecessary raw model output.

source_run_id.title: Source Run Id
source_run_id.description: Project task run from which this evaluation was generated.

account_id.title: Account Id
account_id.description: Account that owns the evaluation run.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: Project within which the evaluation is scoped.

code_commit_or_build_digest.title: Code Commit Or Build Digest
code_commit_or_build_digest.description: Code commit hash or production build digest at lock time.

runtime_identifier.title: Runtime Identifier
runtime_identifier.description: Runtime carrier: conda-agent, manual, unified-cli, docker or podman.

database_migration_version.title: Database Migration Version
database_migration_version.description: Database migration version at lock time.

random_seed.title: Random Seed
random_seed.description: Random seed used for stochastic operations.

model_run_locks.title: Model Run Locks
model_run_locks.description: Immutable model invocation locks captured from the source run.

schema_versions.title: Schema Versions
schema_versions.description: Schema name -> version used during the run.

execution_count.title: Execution Count
execution_count.description: How many times the case should be executed for this run.

network_cache_policy.title: Network Cache Policy
network_cache_policy.description: Network/cache policy: frozen, warm, or online.

EvaluationRunLock.title: EvaluationRunLock
EvaluationRunLock.description:
Immutable snapshot of everything needed to replay an evaluation run.

The lock freezes the task input, code/environment identifier, model locks,
schema versions, workflow version and other reproducibility metadata so that
the same evaluation can be re-executed on any supported runtime carrier.

account_id.title: Account Id
account_id.description: Account that owns the evaluation run.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: Project within which the evaluation is scoped.

status.description: Current status of the evaluation run.

bundle_ids.title: Bundle Ids
bundle_ids.description: Result bundles produced from this lock, in creation order.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: When the evaluation run was created.

EvaluationRunProjection.title: EvaluationRunProjection
EvaluationRunProjection.description: Task-stage / evaluation-center projection of one evaluation run.

EvaluationRunStatus.title: EvaluationRunStatus
EvaluationRunStatus.description: Lifecycle status of an evaluation run.

case_id.title: Case Id
case_id.description: Case identifier within the suite; null for the whole suite.

EvaluationSuiteRef.title: EvaluationSuiteRef
EvaluationSuiteRef.description: Pointer to a registered evaluation suite and case.

document_id.title: Document Id
document_id.description: Document version that produced the evidence.

quoted_span_or_data_ref.title: Quoted Span Or Data Ref
quoted_span_or_data_ref.description: Exact quoted span or structured data reference.

evidence_role.title: Evidence Role
evidence_role.description: Role in the argument, e.g. primary_result, synthesis, standard.

source_proximity.title: Source Proximity
source_proximity.description: How close the evidence is to the original content.

lifecycle_status.description: Lifecycle status of the document version.

assessor.title: Assessor
assessor.description: Agent that produced the assessment: rule, model, human.

model_run_lock_id.title: Model Run Lock Id
model_run_lock_id.description: Model run lock that produced or reviewed this evidence.

Evidence.title: Evidence
Evidence.description:
A source fragment's relationship to a claim.

Evidence is not the literature itself; it records how one or more chunks
from a specific document version relate to a claim (support, refute, limit,
contextualize) and why that relationship was assessed.

EvidenceRelation.title: EvidenceRelation
EvidenceRelation.description: Relationship between a source fragment and a claim.

EvidenceState.title: EvidenceState
EvidenceState.description: Aggregated evidence state for a single claim.

allowed_variants.title: Allowed Variants
allowed_variants.description: Equivalent forms that do not change the fact.

forbidden_transformations.title: Forbidden Transformations
forbidden_transformations.description: Transformations that would violate the lock, e.g. 'upgrade causality'.

required_qualifiers.title: Required Qualifiers
required_qualifiers.description: Qualifiers that must remain attached, e.g. population or conditions.

evidence_ids.title: Evidence Ids
evidence_ids.description: Evidence ids supporting the locked fact.

citation_ids.title: Citation Ids
citation_ids.description: Citation ids bound to the locked fact.

wording_strength_ceiling.description: Maximum wording strength allowed for this claim.

verification_method.title: Verification Method
verification_method.description: How the lock was derived: rule, model, human, domain_pack.

FactLock.title: FactLock
FactLock.description:
A single locked fact derived from a claim and its evidence.

Fact locks are immutable boundaries that downstream expression and
multimodal nodes may not cross. Each lock records the canonical value,
allowed transformations, forbidden transformations, required qualifiers,
and the evidence/citations that justify it.

graph_id.title: Graph Id
graph_id.description: Claim graph this set was compiled from.

FactLockSet.title: FactLockSet
FactLockSet.description: Collection of fact locks compiled from a claim graph.

FactLockType.title: FactLockType
FactLockType.description: Kind of fact locked for a claim.

GateResult.title: GateResult
GateResult.description: Result of a single input quality gate.

service.title: Service
service.description: Service logical name, e.g. api or web.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.description: Additional opaque telemetry; UI must not depend on undocumented keys.

HealthProjection.title: HealthProjection
HealthProjection.description:
Unified health projection exposed by /health/* endpoints and consumed by the Web UI.

live:   process event loop can respond.
ready:  all required dependencies are healthy.
degraded: optional dependencies that are unhealthy or operating in degraded mode.

title.title: Title
title.description: Short title shown in the task stage.

description.title: Description
description.description: Detailed explanation of what is needed.

HumanTodoItem.title: HumanTodoItem
HumanTodoItem.description: A named human decision attached to a run.

HumanTodoStatus.title: HumanTodoStatus
HumanTodoStatus.description: Status of a named human decision attached to a run.

IngestionRunRef.title: IngestionRunRef
IngestionRunRef.description: Reference to an asynchronous ingestion run.

InputQualityGate.title: InputQualityGate
InputQualityGate.description: Named gates that imported content must pass before entering evidence.

LifecycleStatus.title: LifecycleStatus
LifecycleStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a specific document version.

LoginCredential.title: LoginCredential
LoginCredential.description: Request to authenticate with email and password.

MediaType.title: MediaType
MediaType.description: Media type of an imported document.

ModelCallStatus.title: ModelCallStatus
ModelCallStatus.description: Outcome of a single model-gateway invocation.

run_id.title: Run Id
run_id.description: Workflow run that requested the invocation.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: Project within which the run is scoped.

actual_model_id.title: Actual Model Id
actual_model_id.description: Actual vendor model id or alias used.

region.title: Region
region.description: Region where the invocation was routed.

parameters.title: Parameters
parameters.description: Non-secret invocation parameters such as temperature and max_tokens.

input_output_contract.title: Input Output Contract
input_output_contract.description: Identifier of the input/output contract that was honored.

fallback_path.title: Fallback Path
fallback_path.description: Capability names that were attempted, including the primary.

error_code.title: Error Code
error_code.description: Stable error code when the invocation did not succeed.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Token/cache usage metadata if returned by the adapter.

cost_estimate.title: Cost Estimate
cost_estimate.description: Cost estimate metadata; not a billing truth.

ModelRunLock.title: ModelRunLock
ModelRunLock.description:
Immutable snapshot of one model invocation.

The lock records the exact capability, model, region, parameters, prompt
version and contract that were used, so the call can be replayed and audited.

node_id.title: Node Id
node_id.description: Stable node identifier within the workflow.

capability_ref.title: Capability Ref
capability_ref.description: Logical capability reference used by this node, if any.

output_ref.title: Output Ref
output_ref.description: Reference to the typed artifact produced by the node, if any.

NodeProgress.title: NodeProgress
NodeProgress.description: Progress of a single workflow node as shown on the task stage.

NodeStatus.title: NodeStatus
NodeStatus.description: Status of a single workflow node attempt.

ObjectDomain.title: ObjectDomain
ObjectDomain.description:
Authority domain that owns the object.

- PERSONAL_VAULT: owned by an individual account; not visible to collaborators
  or admins by default.
- SHARED_PROJECT: owned by a project, created from an explicit share decision.
- INSTITUTION_OWNED: owned by an institution management domain.

owner_id.title: Owner Id
owner_id.description: Identifier of the owning account, project, or institution.

ObjectRef.title: ObjectRef
ObjectRef.description:
Stable reference to an owned object.

ObjectRef carries enough context to re-authenticate and re-authorize a deep
link without relying on ambient session state alone.

object_domain.description: Authority domain for the project and its objects.

role.description: Current subject's role in the project.

archived_at.title: Archived At
archived_at.description: If set, the project is archived.

Project.title: Project
Project.description:
Public project projection.

Every project is owned by an account, lives in an object domain, and carries
a monotonic version for optimistic concurrency.

ProjectCreateRequest.title: ProjectCreateRequest
ProjectCreateRequest.description: Request to create a new scientific project space.

details.title: Details
details.description: Opaque detail safe for logging; must not expose internal state.

ProjectListProjection.title: ProjectListProjection
ProjectListProjection.description: Collection of projects visible to the current subject.

ProjectRole.title: ProjectRole
ProjectRole.description: Role of the current subject inside a project.

ProjectSummary.title: ProjectSummary
ProjectSummary.description: List item for the project selector.

ProjectUpdateRequest.title: ProjectUpdateRequest
ProjectUpdateRequest.description: Request to rename or update a project.

PublishGateCheck.title: PublishGateCheck
PublishGateCheck.description: Named checks performed by the publish gate.

passed.title: Passed
passed.description: Whether the graph may be published.

PublishGateResult.title: PublishGateResult
PublishGateResult.description: Result of running the claim-graph publish gate.

RecoveryRequest.title: RecoveryRequest
RecoveryRequest.description:
Request a credential recovery flow.

The response is intentionally uniform whether the email is registered or not,
to prevent account enumeration.

token.title: Token
token.description: Recovery token received through the recovery channel.

RecoveryReset.title: RecoveryReset
RecoveryReset.description: Reset password using a recovery token.

candidate_id.title: Candidate Id
candidate_id.description: Stable candidate identifier for this result set.

fused_rank.title: Fused Rank
fused_rank.description: Final rank after fusion and reranking.

lexical_score.title: Lexical Score
lexical_score.description: Raw lexical score; for ranking only.

vector_score.title: Vector Score
vector_score.description: Raw vector similarity score; for ranking only.

fused_score.title: Fused Score
fused_score.description: Fused ranking score; for ranking only.

source_lifecycle_status.description: Lifecycle status of the document version at retrieval time.

source_status.description: Source entry status at retrieval time.

RetrievalCandidate.title: RetrievalCandidate
RetrievalCandidate.description:
A single candidate chunk returned by scoped hybrid retrieval.

Scores are ranking signals only; they are not evidence strength and must not
be shown to users as confidence or truth values.

RetrievalChannel.title: RetrievalChannel
RetrievalChannel.description: Channel that produced a retrieval candidate.

account_id.title: Account Id
account_id.description: Authenticated account that owns the run.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: Project within which the run is scoped.

object_domain.description: Authority domain in which the run executes.

authorization_snapshot.description: Authorization policy version snapshot at compile time.

memory_slice_refs.description: Memory slice identifiers compiled for this run.

domain_pack_refs.title: Domain Pack Refs
domain_pack_refs.description: Domain packs the run must respect.

submitted_at.description: When the WorkOrder was first submitted.

confirmed_at.title: Confirmed At
confirmed_at.description: When the user confirmed the WorkOrder and compilation completed.

terminal_states.title: Terminal States
terminal_states.description: States that legally end this workflow.

RunContextEnvelope.title: RunContextEnvelope
RunContextEnvelope.description:
Immutable execution context carried by a run and every node.

The envelope binds the run to a subject, tenant, project, object domain,
authorization snapshot, key epoch, and declared object scope. It is the source
of truth for refresh, recovery, and audit; it does not depend on chat history.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: Project within which the run is scoped.

artifact_trust_status.description: Scientific trust state of the run's primary artifact.

publish_eligible.title: Publish Eligible
publish_eligible.description: Whether all current conditions allow publishing the artifact.

current_node_id.title: Current Node Id
current_node_id.description: Node currently executing or waiting for input.

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.description: All nodes in the compiled workflow.

human_todos.title: Human Todos
human_todos.description: Open and resolved human decisions for the run.

model_run_locks.title: Model Run Locks
model_run_locks.description: Immutable model invocation locks produced during the run.

context_envelope.description: Immutable execution context for refresh and audit.

RunProjection.title: RunProjection
RunProjection.description:
Task-stage projection of a workflow run.

It separates workflow execution status from artifact trust status and
publish eligibility, so that users do not confuse "finished running" with
"scientifically approved" or "ready to publish".

ScientificQualityGateCheck.title: ScientificQualityGateCheck
ScientificQualityGateCheck.description: Named checks performed by the scientific quality gate.

passed.title: Passed
passed.description: Whether the graph passes the scientific gate.

ScientificQualityGateResult.title: ScientificQualityGateResult
ScientificQualityGateResult.description: Result of running the scientific quality gate over a claim graph.

ScopeAction.title: ScopeAction
ScopeAction.description: Actions that scope isolation can authorize or deny.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: Project within which the operation is scoped.

object_domain.description: Authority domain that owns the target objects.

authorization_version.title: Authorization Version
authorization_version.description: Authorization policy version at compile time.

key_epoch.title: Key Epoch
key_epoch.description: Key epoch under which secrets and capsules are bound.

requested_object_refs.title: Requested Object Refs
requested_object_refs.description: Object references the operation requests to touch.

requested_vault_refs.title: Requested Vault Refs
requested_vault_refs.description: Vault object references the operation requests to touch.

ScopeEnvelope.title: ScopeEnvelope
ScopeEnvelope.description:
Immutable scope snapshot carried by requests, runs, cache keys and RLS.

The envelope binds an operation to a subject, tenant, project, object domain,
authorization version and key epoch. Services must compile it before touching
storage, cache, index or model context.

details.title: Details
details.description: Opaque detail safe for logging; must not expose internal state.

ScopeViolationReport.title: ScopeViolationReport
ScopeViolationReport.description:
Audit-safe report when a scope check fails.

The report intentionally does not include private content, full prompts or
keys; it records only the subject, requested scope, reason and timestamp.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: Project scope; None searches personal vault sources.

object_domain.description: Authority domain that owns the index.

rerank.title: Rerank
rerank.description: Apply reciprocal-rank fusion reranking across channels.

SearchRequest.title: SearchRequest
SearchRequest.description:
Scoped hybrid search request over scientific sources.

The search service compiles a ScopeEnvelope from the authenticated subject,
project, object domain and declared purpose before touching any index.

index_snapshot_id.title: Index Snapshot Id
index_snapshot_id.description: Identifier of the index version used.

lexical_total.title: Lexical Total
lexical_total.description: Number of lexical candidates before fusion.

vector_total.title: Vector Total
vector_total.description: Number of vector candidates before fusion.

SearchResult.title: SearchResult
SearchResult.description:
Result of a scoped hybrid search.

Carries the compiled scope envelope so callers can audit the scope snapshot
that was enforced, and so downstream claim/evidence steps can bind the same
scope. Coverage gaps are reported explicitly rather than silently dropping
channels.

revoked_at.title: Revoked At
revoked_at.description: If set, the session has been revoked and must not be honored.

Session.title: Session
Session.description:
Public session projection.

The opaque session token is only exposed on creation (login/register/recovery).
Subsequent requests use the HttpOnly cookie.

SessionResponse.title: SessionResponse
SessionResponse.description: Response for an existing session lookup.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: Project scope when owned by a project.

canonical_identity.title: Canonical Identity
canonical_identity.description: DOI, arXiv ID, domain or local canonical identifier.

Source.title: Source
Source.description:
A source entry: the identity and ownership of one scientific work.

A Source is not a specific content version; it owns the version history and
current pointer. The actual content snapshots are DocumentVersion objects.

details.title: Details
details.description: Opaque detail safe for logging; must not expose internal state.

SourceLicense.title: SourceLicense
SourceLicense.description: License snapshot for a document version.

can_enter_evidence.title: Can Enter Evidence
can_enter_evidence.description: Whether the source passed all input quality gates.

SourceProjection.title: SourceProjection
SourceProjection.description: Public projection of a source with its current document version.

SourceStatus.title: SourceStatus
SourceStatus.description: Current status of a source entry.

assertion_kind.title: Assertion Kind
assertion_kind.description: Kind of assertion, e.g. peer_reviewed, authoritative_host.

SourceTrustAssertion.title: SourceTrustAssertion
SourceTrustAssertion.description: A recorded trust assertion about a source.

SourceUploadRequest.title: SourceUploadRequest
SourceUploadRequest.description: Request to upload a text or PDF scientific source.

base_document_id.title: Base Document Id
base_document_id.description: Document version to base the new version on.

SourceVersionRequest.title: SourceVersionRequest
SourceVersionRequest.description: Request to create a new document version from a corrected source.

SubjectContext.title: SubjectContext
SubjectContext.description:
Resolved subject for an authenticated request.

This is the canonical object carried by request state, audit logs, and RLS
context. It never includes the session secret.

run_id.title: Run Id
run_id.description: Run to which the capsule is bound.

object_refs.title: Object Refs
object_refs.description: Vault objects authorized for this run.

key_epoch.title: Key Epoch
key_epoch.description: Key epoch used to wrap the capsule.

TemporaryTaskCapsule.title: TemporaryTaskCapsule
TemporaryTaskCapsule.description:
Encrypted minimal context for a single task run.

A temporary task capsule binds subject, purpose, objects, run, authorization
version, key epoch, and TTL. It is the only long-information carrier that may
be sent to cloud workers or model gateways.

wording_strength_ceiling.description: Global wording strength ceiling for the graph.

recovery_actions.title: Recovery Actions
recovery_actions.description: Suggested actions: add_evidence, human_review, revise_claim, block_publish.

ValidationReport.title: ValidationReport
ValidationReport.description:
Report produced by honest-degradation analysis of a claim graph.

The report records the evidence state for each claim, detected conflicts,
missing evidence, fact lock set id, wording strength ceiling, scientific
quality gate result, and recommended recovery actions. It is the input to
downstream expression nodes (T025) and to the task stage (T006).

details.title: Details
details.description: Opaque detail safe for logging; must not expose internal state.

device_id.title: Device Id
device_id.description: Device identifier when content authority is device-local.

projection.description: Cloud control projection for this object.

VaultObject.title: VaultObject
VaultObject.description:
Full vault object projection.

The projection never includes the full content when the content authority is
DEVICE_LOCAL; callers must use the vault port to request content, which may
return DeviceUnavailableState.

content_authority.description: Where the authoritative plaintext will reside.

device_id.title: Device Id
device_id.description: Device identifier when content authority is device-local.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.description: Declared purpose for creating the object.

key_epoch.title: Key Epoch
key_epoch.description: Key epoch under which the object is protected.

VaultObjectCreateRequest.title: VaultObjectCreateRequest
VaultObjectCreateRequest.description:
Request to create a private vault object.

The content is transmitted as a base64-encoded string so that the same
contract works across JSON APIs and port implementations without relying on
framework-specific binary handling.

VaultObjectDomain.title: VaultObjectDomain
VaultObjectDomain.description:
Authority domain that owns the vault object.

- PERSONAL_VAULT: owned by an individual account; not visible to collaborators
  or admins by default.
- SHARED_PROJECT: owned by a project, created from an explicit share decision.
- INSTITUTION_OWNED: owned by an institution management domain.

owner_id.title: Owner Id
owner_id.description: Identifier of the owning account, project, or institution.

VaultObjectRef.title: VaultObjectRef
VaultObjectRef.description:
Stable reference to a vault-owned object.

VaultObjectRef carries enough context to re-authenticate and re-authorize a
deep link without relying on ambient session state alone.

VaultObjectSummary.title: VaultObjectSummary
VaultObjectSummary.description: List item for the vault object selector.

target_project_id.title: Target Project Id
target_project_id.description: Project that will receive the copy.

VaultShareRequest.title: VaultShareRequest
VaultShareRequest.description: Request to share a personal vault object as a minimized project copy.

WordingStrength.title: WordingStrength
WordingStrength.description:
Deterministic ceiling on how strongly a claim may be worded.

The ceiling is derived from evidence state, not from model judgment or user
preference. Domain packs may tighten it; they may not weaken it.

workflow_version.title: Workflow Version
workflow_version.description: Version of the workflow template to compile.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: Project within which the run is scoped.

success_criteria.title: Success Criteria
success_criteria.description: Observable criteria that decide whether the task succeeds.

risk_statement.title: Risk Statement
risk_statement.description: Known risks, limits, or required human oversight.

object_refs.title: Object Refs
object_refs.description: Object identifiers the run is authorized to access.

memory_slice_refs.title: Memory Slice Refs
memory_slice_refs.description: Memory slice identifiers compiled for this run.

domain_pack_refs.title: Domain Pack Refs
domain_pack_refs.description: Domain packs the run must respect.

WorkOrder.title: WorkOrder
WorkOrder.description:
A task submitted by the global science companion for compilation into a run.

The user must confirm the objective, success criteria, and risk statement
before the run leaves the draft state.

confirmed.title: Confirmed
confirmed.description: Must be true to leave the draft state — omitting this field is rejected so that accidental confirmation cannot happen.

WorkOrderConfirmRequest.title: WorkOrderConfirmRequest
WorkOrderConfirmRequest.description:
Explicit user confirmation that starts the compiled run.

The ``confirmed`` field is required (no default) so that an empty request
body is rejected with a clear validation error instead of silently accepted.

details.title: Details
details.description: Opaque detail safe for logging; must not expose internal state.

WorkflowRunStatus.title: WorkflowRunStatus
WorkflowRunStatus.description: Lifecycle status of the workflow orchestration itself.

_CancelRequest.title: _CancelRequest
_CancelRequest.description: Request body for cancelling a run.

_DiffRequest.title: _DiffRequest
_DiffRequest.description: Request body to compare two evaluation result bundles.

_TodoResolveRequest.title: _TodoResolveRequest
_TodoResolveRequest.description: Request body for resolving a human todo.
